html:
OpenMMLab's RTMDet (tiny, s, m, l, x on COCO; nano and m person detectors): real-time one-stage box detector, a CSPNeXt CNN with NMS. The person detectors supply the boxes for RTMPose. Apache-2.0.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: RTMDet: An Empirical Study of Designing Real-Time Object Detectors, arXiv, 2022-12-14
  • Original code: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection at 44ebd17b145c
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection/blob/44ebd17b145c2372c4b700bfb9cb20dbd28ab64a/configs/rtmdet/README.md
  • Training data: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (COCO 2017 train (300 epochs); the CSPNeXt backbones start from ImageNet-1k pretraining (configs/rtmdet/README.md))
    • rtmdet-nano-person: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), Objects365 (train, box annotations), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (persons of COCO 2017 train and Objects365 train (100 epochs; the training config stored in the checkpoint); the CSPNeXt backbone starts from ImageNet-1k pretraining)
    • rtmdet-m-person: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), Objects365 (train, box annotations), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (persons of COCO 2017 train and Objects365 train (100 epochs; the training config stored in the checkpoint); the CSPNeXt backbone starts from ImageNet-1k pretraining)
  • Options: score_threshold = 0.05 (0.0 to 1.0), max_detections = 100 (>= 1), cuda_graphs = True (speed only)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: rtmdet-tiny-coco, rtmdet-s-coco, rtmdet-m-coco, rtmdet-l-coco, rtmdet-x-coco, rtmdet-nano-person, rtmdet-m-person
  • Outputs: boxes, scores, labels; label_set: coco-80
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): rtmdet-tiny-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rtmdet-s-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rtmdet-m-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rtmdet-l-coco 3000x4000 (0.6 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved); rtmdet-x-coco 3000x4000 (0.7 GiB peak allocated, 0.7 reserved); rtmdet-nano-person 3000x4000 (0.4 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rtmdet-m-person 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved)

Limitations

  • The image is resized like OpenCV 4's 8-bit INTER_LINEAR (what mmdetection calls); OpenCV 5 resizes differently by up to two grey levels, so a reference run on OpenCV 5 differs slightly.
  • Boxes are not clamped to the image, as upstream: at the right or bottom border they can reach a few pixels into the padding.
  • The person detectors' released config names COCO only; the training config stored in the checkpoints (and the file name) also lists Objects365.
